sections.body: A TIMELINE shows events in order, from long ago to now.
Long ago, there were no phones or computers. Children wrote letters and played outside with simple toys.
Today, children around the world live in many ways: some walk far to school, some live in cities, some on farms, some by the sea.
Kids everywhere like to play, learn and spend time with family. We're more alike than different!
Ask a grandparent what school was like for them, and add it to a family timeline.

hints: It goes from earlier to later.
Your birthday, then starting school, then today: putting them in order makes a…?
quiz.explain: A timeline shows events in the order they happened.

quiz.q: What do children all around the world have in common?
options: They like to play and learn
hints: Children live in many different places.
Think about what all kids enjoy.
Kids in a village and kids in a city both love games and stories. What's the same?
quiz.explain: Kids everywhere like to play, learn and be with family.
